description: Tuning (8), not a numbered 17 test. Shipped: decay 0.8, reoffend 0.66, tract size absent -> 2, curves as in 8. A curve property present as an empty array gives an empty curve (0); [choice] a scalar where a curve is expected counts as absent (the default stays). Hand-derived.
